name: retrieval_eval_v3_blind_protocol
purpose: Frozen holdout for release decisions; prevents label overfitting to live outputs.

roles.author: Writes draft cases without viewing model answers for those cases.
roles.reviewer: Second person (or non-implementer) verifies labels against corpus only.
roles.operator: Runs blind eval; may not edit labels after seeing results in the same release cycle.

freezeRules: Set frozen=true only after coverage targets are met and reviewerSignoff is present.
While frozen=true, case queries/expected* fields must not change without bumping freezeVersion and documenting why.
Bug fixes to the product may proceed; label edits require a new freezeVersion and are deferred to the next gate.
retrieval_eval_v2 remains the writable development/regression set.
Before freeze and before release scoring, run scripts/validate_retrieval_eval_v3_blind.py --require-frozen.
Holdout cases use split=test so run_rag_pipeline_eval.py --split test --eval-set data/eval/retrieval_eval_v3_blind.json works.
Dataset JSON is authoritative for frozen/freezeVersion/reviewerSignoff; this protocol must mirror that freezeStatus.

coverageTargets.version: prefer superseded-vs-current; if unavailable use related_document_discrimination

reviewerSignoff.scope: Corpus-only second-person review; no model outputs consulted.
reviewerSignoff.labelContractNote: v5: sibling citation + scope mustContain adjudication on product-correct answers.

retirementMetricForInjectionRules.summary: Remove hardcoded companion injection only after frozen blind Acc/CiteP/NA-F1 pass without temporary inject.
procedure: Confirm dataset+protocol freezeStatus.frozen=true and validator --require-frozen passes.
Run Layer-3 blind eval with RAG_COMPANION_INJECT_ENABLED=false (catalog + hardcoded inject both skipped).
Require answerAccuracy, citationPrecision, and noAnswer F1 to meet the same release gate as inject-enabled.
Only then delete temporaryCompatibility relationships and hardcoded fallbacks in document_selection.py.
